from pathlib import Path
program_dir=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL-prime-agent-luna6-medium-fresh0/frozen/held-out-reference/play/users/u036/system/state/workspace/programs')
program_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
path=program_dir/'task-c769e4a7.py'
code='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # The three-color guide is the contiguous nonzero run on the top edge.
    seeds = [(0, c, grid[0][c]) for c in range(w) if grid[0][c] != 0]
    for r0, c0, color in seeds:
        endpoints = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w)
                     if grid[r][c] == color and (r, c) != (r0, c0)]
        if endpoints:
            r, c = endpoints[0]
            # Continue from the guide vertically, then turn to the matching marker.
            for rr in range(min(r0, r), max(r0, r) + 1):
                out[rr][c0] = color
            for cc in range(min(c0, c), max(c0, c) + 1):
                out[r][cc] = color
        else:
            for rr in range(r0, h):
                out[rr][c0] = color
    return out
'''
path.write_text(code)
print(path, path.read_text())
